events.body:
The fare rose because of surge alone: the quote was $10.41 at 1× and the charge $15.06 at 1.6×, with the fare $4.65 above the quote and the surge part (1.6 − 1) × $8.63 = $5.18 capped at $4.65 [F6][F7][F8][SURGE-3]. The route gives no refund of its own: billed distance 2.6 km does not exceed the optimal 2.7 km, so deviation is −0.1 km, inside RD-1 tolerance, and there is no off-route segment to assess under RD-2 / RD-5 [F1][F3].

The surge notice was sent in-app at 21:31:30, before the 21:34 start, so timing under SURGE-1 is met, and the log outweighs the rider's complaint that nothing arrived [F9][F12]. Reading the words of the notice, it states the new multiplier ("1.6× the usual rate") and a revised estimated fare ($15.91); the third required item — that the rider may cancel without penalty — is absent [F9][SURGE-1]. Missing any one item means the rider was not notified, so the full surge differential is refunded [SURGE-2].

No threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation appears, so safety_concern is "none" and no SAFE clause applies.
